name: Maximilian Gruber
bio:
Maximilian's motorsport journey began in his teens, spending countless hours tinkering with go-karts at the local club in Salzburg. He channeled this passion into studying mechanical engineering at the Graz University of Technology, specializing in powertrain development. After graduating, he joined a small Austrian racing team, quickly rising through the ranks due to his meticulous approach and ability to optimize performance under pressure. This led to a role in the support team for a DTM team, before being headhunted by Toyota Gazoo Racing.

As Head of Operations, Maximilian is responsible for ensuring the smooth and efficient functioning of all trackside activities. He is known for his calm demeanor and ability to make critical decisions in high-pressure situations. He believes in empowering his team and fostering a collaborative environment, always pushing for continuous improvement and innovation in every aspect of operations. His methodical nature and relentless pursuit of perfection make him an invaluable asset to Toyota Gazoo Racing.

What truly sets Maximilian apart is his hands-on approach. He isn't afraid to get his hands dirty, often found working alongside the mechanics in the garage, ensuring that every detail is meticulously addressed. This earned him the respect of all the team members.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight fade on the sides.
physical.description: Maximilian is of average height with a lean, athletic build and an intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with meticulously detailed notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific type of Austrian pastry, 'Apfeltasche', every morning.
